test: Single selected Realtek hardware input, native timed stop and tail prompt, isolated CPU ASR
limitations: The user self-reported seeing the tail prompt and sustaining voice until the window stopped; UI countdown and native stop use separate timing observations.
Last-window energy does not identify speech or its content; exact ASR word matches do not establish why a word was missed.
First observed capture is a polling observation, not the actual first-frame timestamp.
Elapsed sample status and segment end do not prove semantic recognition of the tail.
No private audio, actual transcript or their hashes are present here; all remain local.
External native core harness; not product UI stop, GPU concurrency or installer acceptance.
Nonzero end-of-file signal, processed sample count and segment timing do not prove tail semantics were recognized or prove physical preservation of sound after the capture boundary.
